skillPriority: Special Attack > Chain Attack > Assist > Basic Attack > Dodge

entries.name: Basic Attack: Engineering Insurance
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack to activate:
Performs up to four attacks forward, dealing **Fire DMG**.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Hat Trick
entries.text:
When Norma is the active character and is in combat, she gains 1.5% **Preheated Chamber** per second.
When **Top Hat Companion** is on her head, hold Basic Attack to activate:
After firing, Norma throws out **Top Hat Companion**, ordering it to unleash a round of aerial fire, dealing **Fire DMG** and storing the current **Preheated Chamber**.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers the previous character's **Quick Assist**. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
Once **Top Hat Companion** has been thrown out, it will accumulate and retain **Preheated Chamber** at the same speed on behalf of Norma. Norma does not need to stay on the field during this period.
After Norma retrieves the **Top Hat Companion**, she immediately gains the stored **Preheated Chamber**.
When holding Basic Attack, the **Top Hat Companion** will accelerate toward Norma.
If retrieving the **Top Hat Companion** would raise **Preheated Chamber** to 80% or higher, the **Top Hat Companion** will automatically accelerate toward Norma.
When Norma switches from on field to off field while in combat, if **Preheated Chamber** is not full, **Top Hat Companion** automatically enters the battlefield.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

entries.name: Dodge: Development Protocols
entries.text:
Press Dodge to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Dash Attack: Deadline Rush
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a dodge to activate:
Spins while firing at nearby enemies, dealing **Fire DMG**.

entries.name: Dodge Counter: Compliance Testing
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a **Perfect Dodge** to activate:
Commands the Rumble Drill to continuously drill the target, dealing **Fire DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Quick Assist: Roaring Backup
entries.text:
When the active character is launched, press Switch to activate:
Commands the Rumble Drill to continuously attack the target, dealing **Fire DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Defensive Assist: Technological Bastion
entries.text:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press Switch to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of **Assist Points** when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Assist Follow-Up: Technological Suppression
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack after a **Defensive Assist** to activate:
Unleashes a series of attacks, dealing **Fire DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Thermal Shutdown
entries.text:
Press Special Attack to activate:
Bombards enemies, dealing **Fire DMG**.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: En-Nah Barrage
entries.text:
With enough Energy, press EX Special Attack to activate:
Operates the turret to fire continuously and launch different types of missiles based on the target's state:
When the primary target is not Stunned, launches an Armor-Piercing Warhead, dealing **Fire DMG** and inflicting a large amount of **Daze**.
When the primary target is Stunned, launches a High-Explosive Warhead, dealing greater **Fire DMG**.
After using this skill, Norma gains 16% **Preheated Chamber** and enters the **En-Nah Barrage** state for 32s. While **En-Nah Barrage** is active, Norma deploys two **En-Nah Turrets** to join the battle.
Continuing to hold extends the firing time by up to 2s, continuously consuming energy. For each 1 point of energy consumed while holding, Norma gains an additional 0.4% **Preheated Chamber**, and this round of **En-Nah Barrage** lasts 0.8s longer, up to a maximum additional duration of 32s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Target Practice
entries.text: During battle, **En-Nah Turret** automatically attacks enemies, dealing **Fire DMG**.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Explosive Experiment
entries.text:
When any squad member Stuns an enemy, or when Norma consumes **Preheated Chamber** to trigger a **Chain Attack**, **En-Nah Turret** deploys its missile bay for 8s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
During this time, **En-Nah Turrets** automatically attack more frequently. When performing automatic attacks, they launch different missiles based on the enemy's state:
When the primary target is not Stunned, launch an Armor-Piercing Warhead, dealing **Fire DMG** and inflicting a large amount of **Daze**.
When the primary target is Stunned, launch a High-Explosive Warhead, dealing greater **Fire DMG**.

entries.name: Chain Attack: Impact Drill
entries.text:
When a **Chain Attack** is triggered, select the character to activate:
Commands a swarm of Rumble Drills to deal multiple hits, dealing massive **Fire DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Ultimate: Doctrine of Superior Firepower
entries.text:
When Decibel Rating is at **Maximum**, press Ultimate to activate:
Calls in tactical artillery to bombard enemies ahead, dealing massive **Fire DMG**.
Upon activation, immediately gains 30% **Preheated Chamber**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Core Passive: Precise Guidance
entries.text:
When initial CRIT Rate exceeds 50%, every additional 1% increases her CRIT DMG by **1.7%**, up to a maximum increase of **85%**.
When initial CRIT Rate exceeds 50%, every additional 1% increases the Daze dealt by her **EX Special Attack**, **Special Attack**, and **Ultimate** by **0.8%** when they hit an enemy, up to a maximum increase of **40%**.
Norma gains additional ATK based on her Sheer Force. Every 1 point of Sheer Force increases her ATK by 1.25, up to a maximum increase of 1,200 ATK.
Upon entering the battlefield, Norma immediately gains 60% **Preheated Chamber**. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
When **Preheated Chamber** is at least 80%, the next **Basic Attack: Hat Trick** can trigger a **Quick Assist** regardless of cooldown, and consumes 80% **Preheated Chamber** to replace the **Quick Assist** with a **Chain Attack**.

entries.name: Additional Ability: Advantage in Numbers
entries.text:
When another character in your squad is an **Attack** or **Rupture** character, or shares the same Faction:
When Norma, her creations, or Combat Bangboo hit an enemy, they apply 1 stack of **Tech Divide**. Each stack of **Tech Divide** increases the target's Stun DMG Multiplier by 3%, stacking up to 10 times. This effect can stack once every 0.5s.
Enemies with **Tech Divide** stacks have their Stun duration increased by 2s upon becoming Stunned. This Stun duration increase cannot stack with similar effects. When an enemy affected by **Tech Divide** recovers from Stun, the **Tech Divide** effect ends.
While **En-Nah Barrage** is active, Norma's ATK increases by 44. This effect scales with character level, increasing by 14 per level, up to a maximum increase of 870.
While **En-Nah Barrage** is active, DMG dealt by all squad members increases by **20%**.

entries.name: Visionary Extremism
entries.text:
The duration of the En-Nah Turret's missile bay deployed by **EX Special Attack: Explosive Experiment** increases to 12s.
When an Armor-Piercing Warhead or High-Explosive Warhead from any skill hits an enemy, the target's All-Attribute RES is reduced by 15% for 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

entries.name: Axiom of Universal Unity
entries.text:
The Stun DMG Multiplier granted by each stack of **Tech Divide** in Norma's **Additional Ability: Advantage in Numbers** is increased to 6%.
When Norma uses **Basic Attack: Hat Trick** while in combat, she gains 25 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 20s.

entries.name: Natural-Born Villain Paradox
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Bangboo Superiority Theory
entries.text: When Norma consumes **Preheated Chamber** to trigger a **Chain Attack**, both Norma and the corresponding Agent gain 200 Decibels.

entries.name: En-Nah Big Bang
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: The Primary Cause of Genius
entries.text:
After any squad member Stuns an enemy, Norma will continuously summon missiles to bombard random enemies on the field for 6s. A missile is launched every 0.75s, dealing **Fire DMG** equal to 200% of Norma's ATK to enemies within the area. This DMG is considered **Ultimate** DMG. Repeated triggers reset the duration. This effect can trigger once every 30s.
The Daze inflicted by Armor-Piercing Warhead increases by **30%**, and the DMG dealt by High-Explosive Warhead increases by **30%**.
